definitions.gloss: blessing; good fortune that comes with one's role
definitions.explanation: The good fortune or joy that a particular role, job, or position brings. Almost always used in the set phrase 〜{冥利|みょうり}に{尽|つ}きる.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧{冥利|みょうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧。
examples.english: It is the greatest joy a teacher can have.

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んで→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧⟦もらえて→もらう：00520_morau⟧、{作|つく}り{手|て}{冥利|みょうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尽|つ}きます→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing you so pleased is the greatest reward a maker could ask for.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教|おし}え{子|ご}→教え子：12874_oshiego⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧{冥利|みょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: When I hear about my former students' success, I feel the joy of being a teacher.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{冥利|みょうり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧: to be the greatest happiness that being a ~ can bring
- ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧{冥利|みょうり} / ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧{冥利|みょうり}: the good fortune of being a man / woman
- ⟦{役者|やくしゃ}→役者：05113_yakusha⟧{冥利|みょうり}: an actor's greatest joy

USAGE:
The noun before {冥利|みょうり} names the speaker's own role (⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧, ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧, ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧), and the phrase expresses heartfelt gratitude for a moment that makes the role worthwhile. Originally a Buddhist word for blessings received unseen.
